requirement: Produce nine separately identifiable logical deliverables.
action_or_output: Map 01..09 to explicit purpose/audience/source/format and create all 9 after authorization.
failure_policy: Missing logical deliverable blocks Step19 PASS.
claim_boundary: Physical packaging may consolidate sheets but not erase logical deliverables.

requirement: Limit top-level client business/page model to <=15 primary directions.
action_or_output: Build top-level model with nested specialist/supporting pages.
failure_policy: >15 primary directions blocks package-scope acceptance unless owner changes scope.
claim_boundary: Detailed workbook may retain more rows/pages.
qa_acceptance: PRIMARY_DIRECTIONS<=15 and detail not silently dropped.

requirement: Create a short decision-maker summary separate from detailed evidence.
action_or_output: Write 01_CLIENT_SUMMARY last from reconciled 02-08.
failure_policy: Summary written from memory or unsupported claims blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: Summary is not a substitute for detailed evidence.
qa_acceptance: Every material summary claim traces to detailed output/evidence.

requirement: Every material finding must lead to action/no-action/HOLD/next decision.
action_or_output: Add what/why/scope/next-state fields to action-facing views.
failure_policy: Raw observation without decision context is not sufficient client output.
claim_boundary: Do not create new analytical decisions merely to fill a client field.
qa_acceptance: Material findings have practical next-state or explicit no-action/HOLD.

requirement: Keep analytical priority separate from implementation schedule.
action_or_output: 07 and 01 label P1/P2/P3 as analytical priority; show PENDING_CALIBRATION.
failure_policy: Any committed schedule wording without calibration blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: No sprint/calendar/effort/owner inference.

research_finding_or_rule: One canonical truth feeding many views
requirement: Build canonical client data model before nine deliverables.
action_or_output: Normalize task/page/action/evidence/priority/limitation relationships and derive client views.
failure_policy: Manual divergent copies or contradictory current facts block PASS.
claim_boundary: Aggregation is allowed only with reverse traceability.
qa_acceptance: Duplicate canonical entities/actions=0; reverse trace PASS.

requirement: Use only current accepted source artifacts and later overlays.
action_or_output: Freeze Step14/14A current architecture, Step17 bounded cases, Step18 final priority/readiness and accepted semantic lineage.
failure_policy: Superseded intermediate decision shown as current blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: Historical evidence may be shown only if explicitly labelled historical.

requirement: Preserve complete accepted phrase/task/page lineage with client-useful fields.
action_or_output: Build 03 workbook from current accepted mappings with explicit NA/UNKNOWN/NOT_OBSERVED semantics.
failure_policy: Silent phrase/mapping loss or ambiguous blank blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: Client top-level presentation limits do not justify row loss.
qa_acceptance: Phrase-level accounting and mapping/demand lineage PASS.

requirement: Use exactly accepted Step17 cases and preserve sampling/claim boundaries.
action_or_output: Build 04 with 8/8 exact cases, Search/AI observations, verdicts, provenance, temporal/sampling class and limitations.
failure_policy: New cases/acquisition or generalized visibility claim blocks PASS unless proper analytical step reopened.
claim_boundary: No sitewide AI visibility, longitudinal stability or business-impact claim.

requirement: Translate current architecture/actions without resurrecting superseded decisions.
action_or_output: Build 05 from Step14/14A + Step18 current actions/work packages.
failure_policy: Old conflicting action as current blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: No unauthorized new page/destructive action.
qa_acceptance: Action map reconciles with current authorities.

requirement: Deliverable 06 is a bounded observations view, not a new competitor audit.
action_or_output: Extract only actually observed prior Search/AI sources/competitors with query/surface/date/scope.
failure_policy: Market-share/full-landscape inference or new hidden acquisition blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: Observation does not imply competitor dominance.
qa_acceptance: All rows trace to prior observed evidence.

requirement: Keep material unresolved blockers visible.
action_or_output: Represent HOLD reason, consequence and recheck trigger in 01/07/08 and detail where relevant.
failure_policy: Hiding HOLD or downgrading it as low value blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: HOLD is unresolved, not rejected.
qa_acceptance: Every material HOLD shown with meaning/recheck.

requirement: Client output must be understandable without repository/SEO jargon.
action_or_output: Translate technical labels into practical language; keep IDs only as optional trace fields.
failure_policy: Internal IDs/terms as sole explanation fail readability QA.
claim_boundary: Technical precision may remain in supporting columns/method file.

research_finding_or_rule: Business relevance vs private business importance
requirement: Do not invent margin/lead value/internal strategic priority.
action_or_output: Use supported public business relevance and label missing client-private business calibration.
failure_policy: Private business-value guess blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: Analytical importance is not proven profitability.

requirement: Distinguish implementation verification, uncertainty recheck and performance outcome measurement.
action_or_output: Carry Step18 measurement classes into 07/08 where relevant; describe Webmaster/Metrika only as future/optional when not observed.
failure_policy: Recheck trigger presented as success metric or unobserved metric as current evidence blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: No ranking/traffic/lead/revenue guarantee.

requirement: Use logical executive-to-detail-to-action sequence.
action_or_output: Order client navigation around summary, model/evidence, actions/priorities, method/limitations and delivery guidance.
failure_policy: Data dump without context/action fails usability QA.
claim_boundary: Exact physical file order may optimize usability while retaining 01..09 identities.

requirement: Preserve underlying 112 packages while grouping for readability.
action_or_output: 07 can group workstreams but keeps mapping from grouped client item to exact source actions/packages.
failure_policy: 46 routes/15 links/20 HOLD presented as single executable tasks without detail blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: Grouping does not assign owner/effort/timeline.

research_finding_or_rule: Step19 construction QA != Step20 final QA
requirement: Keep independent final-QA stage intact.
action_or_output: Run Step19 self-QA/readback, then leave Step20 NOT STARTED.
failure_policy: Marking final QA complete in Step19 blocks correct transition.
claim_boundary: Step20 remains separate independent review.

requirement: Keep Step21 independent.
action_or_output: Create 09 as draft usage/delivery message only.
failure_policy: Marking handoff/delivery complete in Step19 is forbidden.
claim_boundary: Actual delivery/revisions occur in Step21.

requirement: No fresh provider call merely for richer presentation.
action_or_output: Reuse persisted evidence; stop at separate authorization only for a named material evidence gap.
failure_policy: Unauthorized/low-information call blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: Provider capability != provider need.
qa_acceptance: NEW_PROVIDER_CALLS=0 unless separately authorized and justified.

requirement: Every view must agree on page/task/action/priority/limitation truth.
action_or_output: Run forward/reverse trace and pairwise authority checks before completion.
failure_policy: Any material contradiction blocks PASS.
claim_boundary: Different wording/aggregation allowed; factual decision may not diverge.

requirement: Persist and reopen generated artifacts before claiming completion.
action_or_output: Write outputs + QA/state, perform GitHub/file readback and record final seal.
failure_policy: Write success without readback is insufficient.
claim_boundary: Readback verifies content/state, not merely file existence.
